plan: A Void creature who digs tunnels and bursts out of the ground to knock up her enemies.
aSurveiller: Her W (Un-burrow). She bursts out of the ground and knocks you up: be careful when she's burrowed near you.
contrer: Be careful when she's underground: she can burst out beneath you.
Her tunnels let her come back quickly: keep an eye on them.
Her R takes her to a wounded target: keep your health high.
forces: Very strong in the early game.

sorts.P: Generates fury that heals her once burrowed.
sorts.W: Burrows; bursts out and knocks up.
